official_definition: (Flash) Twinkle Revolution (When Attacks) By discarding 4 Spirit cards from the family "Ancient Dragon"/"Magician" with the same cost from your Hand/Removed from Game Zone, until next activation of Twinkle Revolution, switch opponent's [Refresh Step] and [Attack Step].

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Twinkle Revolution] or [Twinkle Revolution: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Twinkle Revolution]", "give [Twinkle Revolution]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
